primary_sources.title: Junyi Xie, Intersections of valuation rings in k[x,y], author postprint dated December28,2015; published PLMS111(2015),240-274
primary_sources.used_statement: Theorem1.2 on complete PDF3: transcendence degree2 of polynomial intersection of divisorial valuation rings iff the UNNORMALIZED dual-divisor intersection matrix is negative definite. The complete main-proof conclusion on PDF32 is also checked; the Section2 incomplete sketch is not imported as a proof.

other_literature_audits.integral_coordinate_not_normal_generatio: Already retained PF2RULED38 norm/conductor gate; no such implication imported.
other_literature_audits.web_rational_curves: Trivial normal bundles after extra infinity extraction do not prove positivity on the original simultaneous model; no web-classification theorem imported.
other_literature_audits.pinchuk_surface: Peretz2011 Theorem2.9 is a restricted real-function-ring statement, and Remark2.10 explicitly distinguishes it from full complex etale exoticity. It is not imported as an obstruction to all exact unramified component models.
